questions.name: contribution
questions.instructions: Classify this report's contribution to the selected event. If no event was selected use unrelated; if a new event is being created use new_event. Explicit reposts do not add independent sources. Independent authors may still repeat one upstream claim. Support is claim-specific: medical attendance does not confirm serious injury. A resolution claim requires review and applies only to its stated place and incident. Unlocated content remains unmatched; it must not attach to a convenient Paris event.

questions.name: paris_action
questions.instructions:
Choose the new-report action for the Paris queue. Follow this ordered policy, using report content and selected prior evidence. IGNORE retains the record. Prior severity remains visible at event level.
IGNORE new Paris alert creation for explicit Lyon, Nantes, or national-only reports; retain separately with their reported severity. IGNORE irrelevant content.
IGNORE duplicate or historical reports as new alert triggers; preserve their links, disputes and any existing event action.
REVIEW local corrections, conflicts, or resolution claims; do not clear the event automatically.
REVIEW possibly relevant serious claims with unknown event location or unknown timing.
URGENT_REVIEW a current or upcoming Paris report with an explicit level-3 claim, even when unverified.
REVIEW a level-2 Paris report or unclear relevant pathway.
MONITOR planned/current Paris gatherings, transport context or routine donation information.
IGNORE otherwise. No action here orders transfers or asserts that blood is needed.

questions.name: event_action
questions.instructions: What review priority should the selected/new event now retain, for its own geographical route? Do not apply the Paris exclusion to a Lyon event. Preserve unresolved earlier serious claims through duplicates and historical material; an incomplete weaker account does not clear them. Corrections or resolution reports require REVIEW. No event means IGNORE.

questions.name: event_status
questions.instructions: What is the evidence/lifecycle state of the selected/new event after this report? A single resolution report supports resolution_reported, not automatic closure. No event: use normal.

questions.name: tag_UNVERIFIED
questions.instructions: Does an important claim in this report remain unverified by the supplied evidence? An authenticated account does not prove every claim.

questions.name: tag_DUPLICATE
questions.instructions: Does this report simply repeat an earlier report's claim without adding substantive information?

questions.name: tag_CONFLICTING
questions.instructions: Does this report conflict with an earlier claim, or repeat a claim already disputed in the prior event evidence?

questions.name: tag_LOCATION_UNCLEAR
questions.instructions: Is the reported incident's location unknown? A named non-Paris city is not an unknown location.

questions.name: tag_TIME_UNCLEAR
questions.instructions: Is the reported incident's time unknown? An explicitly old incident has known past timing.

questions.name: tag_RESOLUTION_REPORTED
questions.instructions: Does this report claim that the specific local interruption or incident has ended? This is a reported resolution, not a verified citywide all-clear.
